lines: Undoing the mismatched buttons, one by one.
Take them off from the bottom and layer them again.
The time and warmth you gave me.
My heart tells me so.
That the sky is blue, that flowers bloom.
That you laugh, that you hold me.
This happiness that was right beside me.
I feel it now, almost painfully.
If there’s something I want to protect, there’s a future there.
I’ll come to fetch you wherever you are.
If the rain and wind beat us to pieces.
Laugh at my clumsy shape.
If there’s a world only visible because I’ve fallen once.
I won’t let go of that hand again.
I finally realized the days I spend with you.
What I truly wanted is right there.
With a face that’s walked alone.
I finally woke up after almost losing it.
The warmth of the presence that was beside me.
I am, indeed, a great fool.
My weakness I’m learning for the first time.
And this childishness I couldn’t fully hide.
You must have known that.
And yet you believed in me.
There’s something I want to give back, something I want to find.
I’ll come to fetch you wherever you are.
Even if the rain and wind tear us to shreds.
I’ll go to convey this unchanging longing.
Both the tears I overlooked and the feelings I swapped.
Run, run, as if to reclaim them.
There is no duplicate, only a single brilliance.
The joy of supporting each other.
The sorrow we can share.
Someday becoming an unshakable form.
Even if I search the whole world, it exists only here.
If you call that love.
If there’s something I want to protect, there’s a future there.
I’ll come to fetch you wherever you are.
Now I can say it clearly, my dear.
I want you to stay by my side forever.
